```{r, echo=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, dplyr, chromote)
```

```{r}
# parks stewardship data
parks <- read_csv('../data/parks_name.csv', col_select = 1:5)
# parks spending data
spend <- read_csv("../data/parks_spending.csv")
```

```{r}
# SCRAPES IRMA FOR VISITATION DATA OVER EACH PARK. 
# do not need to run every time
# last updated october 10, 2026

source("scrape.R")

park_code <- unique(na.omit(spend$Park))

chrome <- ChromoteSession$new()

results <- lapply(
  park_code,
  function(code) {
    
    file_path <- file.path(
      "../data/visitation",
      paste0(code, ".csv")
    )
    
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      message("skipping ", code, ": already exists")
      
      return(read.csv(
        file_path,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        check.names = FALSE
      ))
    }
    
    message("scraping ", code, "...")
    
    get_visitation(
      park_code = code,
      chrome = chrome
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
month_cols <- c(toupper(month.abb), "Year_vis")

park_vis <- lapply(park_code, function(park) {
  
  file_path <- file.path(
    "../data/visitation",
    paste0(park, ".csv")
  )
  
  data <- read.csv(
    file_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    colClasses = "character"
  )
  
  data[month_cols] <- lapply(
    data[month_cols],
    function(x) as.numeric(gsub(",", "", x))
  )
  
  data$Year <- as.integer(data$Year)
  data$Park <- park
  
  data
})

full <- bind_rows(park_vis)
write.csv(full, "../data/full_vis.csv", row.names = FALSE)

full

#length(unique(full$Park))
```

```{r}
full$log_tot <- log(full$Year_vis)  
```

```{r}

total <- right_join(full, spend, by = c("Year", "Park"))
write.csv(total, "../data/total.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
